sentence_stem: If only I had listened to my teacher,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had listened to my teacher, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have done much better.

options.text: I am going to listen now.
options.why_wrong: The stem expresses regret about the past, so the completion needs a past conditional, not a present or future verb.

options.text: so I can pass the exam now.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a present result, but the stem talks about a past regret that cannot be changed.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.

options.why_wrong: This describes the teacher, but it does not complete the regret expressed by 'if only'.

grammar_focus: Third conditional wishes with 'if only' and past perfect
explanation: After 'if only' followed by a past perfect verb, the second clause uses 'would have' plus a past participle to express regret about a situation that did not happen.
